free_tier.stated: anonymous guest read of 11 root entries; no account and no payment

per_object_cap.stated: the upstream provider's cap; the instance publishes none

retention.stated: until the operator's account or tenant fails; no TTL and no notice

egress.terms: served through nginx; the reader pays nothing

tooling: the AList/OpenList REST surface (/api/fs/list, /api/fs/get, /api/fs/put) and the WebDAV endpoint at /dav; the rclone alist backend speaks the REST
chaining: a fetch substrate: point a cache and two mirrors at it, never a write tier

limits.value: write accepted but the read-back is signed

identity_cost.detail: no registration; /api/me returns a guest session

reliability_note: The read-gated write. PUT returns code 200 with message success, and GET /p/ then returns 51 bytes of code 401 expire missing: the instance signs its raw path and a guest cannot mint the signature. Provider 139Yun. The bytes went in and cannot come out.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, JSON carrying a code field, site_title '美辰云盘'
anonymous POST /api/fs/list on / returned code 200 with 11 root entries; write:true, write_content_bypass:None, provider:139Yun
the zero-byte oracle returned code 403 with message 'file exists', so the write permission passed and nothing was written
GET /p/<the written path> returned HTTP 200 with 51 bytes of code 401 'expire missing' instead of the 32 bytes written
the settings request for this host answered HTTP 200 at this instant
the anonymous root listing hashed to this value in this run
the probe record states the hash method used for the listing
